matches.quote: To generate the bi-monthly or monthly financial and medical provider reimbursement reports on claims per provider, using standard or customized report formats as specified for MSIU.

The user requests generation of the bi-monthly or monthly financial and medical provider reimbursement report on claims per provider, based on the VSP payment terms, using the standard report format specified for MSIU.
The system generates the provider reimbursement report on claims per provider from the processed claim data stored in the Database.

If the report required for the reporting period must be produced in a customized format rather than the standard report format, the system generates the customized financial and medical provider reimbursement report.

The Client Feedback form is available and ready to capture required details including Voucher No, Client Details, Details of syndromes treated, Lab Test, Drugs Details, Success of Treatment, Referral To Treatment, Satisfaction of Treatment, Satisfaction of counseling, Satisfaction of ensuring privacy, and Partner Treated.

MSIU Field Office User
The MSIU Field Office User initiates the 'Record Client Feedback' function within the Voucher Management System.
The system presents the Client Feedback form for data entry.
The user enters or selects the 'Voucher No'.

Based on the Voucher No, the system automatically populates available client and treatment details (such as Client Details, Details of syndromes treated, Lab Test, Drugs Details, Success of Treatment, Referral To Treatment) as per design constraints.

The user submits the completed Client Feedback form.
The system validates the submitted data, ensuring consistency and completeness.
Upon successful validation, the system saves the client feedback record to the database.
The system confirms successful recording of the feedback to the user.

The client feedback record, including Voucher No, Client Details, Details of syndromes treated, Lab Test, Drugs Details, Success of Treatment, Referral To Treatment, Satisfaction of Treatment, Satisfaction of counseling, Satisfaction of ensuring privacy, and Partner Treated, is successfully saved in the system database.
The data entered for the client feedback is available for future retrieval, reporting, and analysis within the Voucher Management System.

matches.quote: The system detects that the thumb impression available in the claim form mismatches with previous visits for the same patient (Client / Partner) on the same voucher number. The system automatically increments a mismatch count.

During thumb impression validation, the system detects a mismatch between the current claim's thumb impression and previous visits for the same patient (Client/Partner) using the same voucher number. The system automatically increments a mismatch counter for that voucher-patient pair but continues processing unless the threshold is exceeded.

UC-c0e26d379fe00f5a-R0029.rationale: The output clearly states the system automatically counts mismatches for the same patient/voucher, matching the requirement.

UC-c0e26d379fe00f5a-R0030.label: FULL

matches.quote: The system detects that the same VSP has submitted claims with more than two thumb impression mismatches. The system automatically produces a warning message and inactivates the VSP.

If the system detects that the same VSP has submitted claims with more than two thumb impression mismatches (across any vouchers/patients), it automatically generates a warning message and changes the VSP’s status to 'In-Active', preventing further claim submissions from that VSP until reactivated by authorized personnel.

UC-c0e26d379fe00f5a-R0030.rationale: The output covers both the warning message and VSP inactivation for more than two mismatches, as required.
